accidentally-become-a-father:
“Papa, it’s me. Your daughter.”
I don’t have a child.
Twenty-one-year-old Itsuki is barely scraping by when a little girl suddenly shows up at his door, carrying an official birth certificate bearing his name.
Name: Yuna.
Date of birth: Nine years ago.
Father: Nishida Itsuki.
Mother: Kanzaki Sayaka.
Kanzaki Sayaka—a top-tier idol who exists in a world utterly beyond his reach.
Standing inside his cramped 1K apartment, Itsuki is forced to make a choice: reject this impossible reality, or surrender to a scenario meticulously orchestrated by a nine-year-old child.
Because behind Yuna’s impossibly calm smile, Itsuki knows this isn't just a game of playing house.
It's the beginning of something incredibly troublesome.

became-the-terminally-ill-supporting-mal:
In the book, the supporting male lead is the older brother of the female lead. The supporting lead has a cold and desolate personality and is despised by the female lead due to his terminal illness. However, when the female lead acted viciously and was abandoned by everyone, he still protected her, sacrificing everything for her and even dying for her.
Su Ci has transmigrated into the book, becoming a little rabbit raised by the supporting male lead, and she has discovered that her life is tied together with this terminally ill supporting male lead.
After becoming a little rabbit, Su Ci can only sleep on the supporting male lead’s dusty bed every day, eat withered carrots, and guard against the female lead, who occasionally tries to pluck her rabbit fur. To turn back into a human, she needs to find ways to get close to him every day.
The supporting male lead noticed that lately, his pet rabbit always wanted to kiss him. Until one night, he leaned down and kissed this soft little creature, and it unexpectedly transformed into a beautiful little fairy!
…
The female lead encountered trouble, so she went to look for the supporting male lead, whom she always looked down upon.…

descending-into-a-novel:
“If you could turn back time in order to save everybody, even if you would be forgotten by the world would you still do it?”
“Yes, I owe it to them to at least try.”
...
The world has ended.
Only a single survivor is left. Seeing the ruins, Raymond in an impulsive decision chooses to reverse time. Sending the whole world 25 years into the past but in the process gets stuck inside the world he wrote a novel about!
With the world soon about to face a calamity, all I want is to go back home and enjoy a calm peaceful life...
So why have I become the shadow of my favorite character and is now forced to obey her every command?
Money? Fame? Who cares about that when the demon king is arriving soon!
I just want to live a comfortable life!
------------------------------------------

divorced-by-the-alpha-claimed-by-the-rog:
“You were mine once,” Aiden murmured, pinning her to the wall. “And you will be mine again.”
Alina laughed softly, even as tears burned her eyes. “You chose another woman, Aiden. Now you don’t get to touch what you abandoned.”
Three years of silence. Three years of cold sheets. Three years of being the “Placeholder Luna.”
Alina knew the terms: marry the powerful Alpha Aiden, provide an heir, and disappear when the contract expired. She played her part perfectly. But when Aiden’s childhood sweetheart returns to claim her throne, the rejection isn't just a formality—it’s a betrayal that leaves Alina shattered and exiled to the pack’s dangerous fringes.
Then, an accident comes that almost claims her life. Instead of death, she finds a savior: a scarred rogue, hunted by every pack in the territory. Where Aiden saw a contract, this stranger sees a Queen. Where Aiden saw a wolfless Omega, he sees a mate.
As the Rogue’s obsession with Alina grows, so does the danger. But back at the palace, Aiden is realizing that breaking the bond didn't stop the hunger. He wants his wife back. He wants his son home.…
dragons-slice-of-life:
I Was Born as a Dragon Prince… But Can’t my life be little peaceful?
Hatched as the son of the strongest Dragon Empress, life should be all about power, glory, and world domination—should be. But honestly? That sounds exhausting. All this prince wants is a life of cuddles, snacks, and afternoon naps in his mother’s lap.
Too bad his doting mother, a yandere maid, and his overprotective older sister have other plans—plans that usually involve him getting smothered, spoiled, or dragged into chaos. And let’s not even mention his aunt, who seems a little too happy to have him around.
But can he truly live the slow life when he’s the center of everyone’s obsession? With dragons, elves, and who-knows-what-else vying for his attention, peace might be harder to find than treasure in a dragon’s hoard.
———————————————
[Warning: This novel contains degeneracy, fluff, and enough family bonding to make you question your morals.]
A heartwarming, chaotic, and slightly unhinged slice-of-life story where the strongest creatures in the world fight over who gets to spoil the prince the most. Wholesome? Yes. Unhinged? Absolutely.
Will he survive their love… or just give in and enjoy it?
Hop in.…

farming-after-the-end-of-the-world:
[Post-Apocalypse | Farming | Animal Companions | Cozy Survival]
Ten years of nuclear contamination, volcanic eruptions, and a gamma-ray burst that wiped out two continents.
Xia Qing survived all of it.
Now, while everyone else clings to the safety zones — rationing water, fighting for scraps, never daring to step outside — she walks out the gate with her head held high.
Don't anyone stop me. I'm going to farm.
The sheep in the territory? Companions. The wolves in the surrounding Evolution Forest? Neighbors. Bears? Trading partners. Monkeys and squirrels? My employees!
Day by day, season by season, Xia Qing turns a wasteland into something worth protecting — a farm where things actually grow, animals actually cooperate, and life actually feels good again.
It's been ten years since the world ended.
florida-mans-general-store-in-cultivatio:
In a world where martial artists reign supreme, strength is everything. Unfortunately, that logic doesn't apply to a certain Florida Man.
Refined in the nuclear fallout wasteland, Leo was the strongest mutant alive. He carried an alien artifact, allowing him to exchange his lifespan for modern items. After 50,000 years of solitary life in a humanless world, he collected enough lifespan to transmigrate to another habitable world.
Leo was later thrown into a mysterious planet. He soon discovered that his body produced radiation, and it mutated the surrounding plants and grasses. Worrying that he might ruin the beautiful planet, he chose to live in seclusion.
Unfortunately, the local population soon discovered his existence, and a misunderstanding ensued.

She had infuriated her boss and left the previous company. In return, the company attacks her mom. Plus with the power behind the company, no hospital is ready to treat her mom.
Thus left with no option, Kizy had to go and plead Markus for saving her mom.
Markus, most eligible bachelor in country B with a godly handsome face. He is no.1 business tycoon. But only a few people know that Markus is actually the current mafia leader of underworld in country B.
And unknown to others, he has a past with Kizy. To put it in plain words, they both can be called sworn enemies. They have known each other since childhood and hate ech other to the core. Thus when Kizy approaches him, she isn't much hopeful.

formula-1-the-goat:
Abandoned at birth and raised in an orphanage, a young man endures twenty-five years confined to a body ravaged by a rare genetic disease that kept him in constant pain and left him bedridden in his final years. His life ends quietly, without fanfare, as the flatline echoes through his lonely room.
But death isn’t the end.
Awakening in a realm of pure nothingness, he’s offered the one thing life never gave him: a second chance, and with it, a system shaped from his deepest desires.
Given the opportunity to be reborn with the potential to become the Greatest of All Time in any field, his decision is instant. He chooses Formula 1, the one passion that kept him going during his darkest hours.
Armed with a custom-built system, a new life, and the relentless drive of someone who has truly suffered, he is reborn in 2003. This time, he won’t just watch from the sidelines.

gods-slave-reincarnated-into-an-academy-:
After getting hit by a car, Nolan thought death would bring him peace. But instead of resting in heaven, he wakes up in a world of gods and power.
Reincarnated in the Academy of Heavenly Descendants, Nolan now finds himself surrounded by the heirs of mythological deities—each wielding divine power beyond imagination.
But there's a problem: the body he reincarnated into is cursed.
Without the ability to cultivate Divine Essence, Nolan is labeled as worthless, an outcast in a world where strength means everything.
Just as he’s about to lose hope, a voice echoes in his mind:
[Congratulations, Host Has Awakened The God King System!]
[Initial Bloodline Scan Beginning...]
[Scan Completed]
[Host Has Awakened the Power of Kratos, the God of Strength and War!]
Equipped with a system that enables him to contract thousands of various mythological bloodlines, Nolan journeys across the limitless planes of existence, searching for the absolute power to achieve his ultimate goal—freedom!
A path many have embarked on, but none have succeeded.

Firstly, what in the world is the “Instantaneous Outbreak of Acute Gastroenteritis” spell? And don’t even get me started on the “Osteoporosis” spell. The confusion only deepened with spells like “Blood Burn,” “Gradual Freeze,” and “Mental Chaos.” Can I still peacefully focus on healing women with such ominous abilities?
Comparing my spells to those of other professions, I couldn’t help but notice the stark contrast. Mages wield “Doomstorm” and “Ice Age,” swordsmen boast “Sword Rain: Homecoming” and “Wind-Cutter Slash,” while archers showcase “Arrow Rain: Shooting Stars” and “Storm Arrow.” Yet, my ultimate spells are disturbingly named “Cancer Cell Proliferation,” “T-Virus Infection,” and “Rabies Outbreak.…

leo-journey-into-a-new-world:
Leo awakens in the body of a twelve-year-old boy with no memories of his past. Alone in an unfamiliar world filled with monsters, hidden dangers, and ancient mysteries, he struggles to survive while searching for the truth about his identity.
Just as hope begins to fade, a mysterious System awakens within him, granting quests, rewards, and opportunities to grow stronger. But every answer he uncovers only raises more questions. Who was he before? Why was he brought to this world? And what secret does the System hide?
From dangerous wildernesses and forgotten ruins to powerful kingdoms and ancient civilizations, Leo must forge his own path in a world where strength determines fate. As his power grows, so does the scale of the mysteries surrounding him, leading him toward a destiny that could reshape the world itself.
lost-treasure:
A disappearing gold mine. An old family secret. An army officer carrying a grudge spanning two generations.
As a small time reporter at the local newspaper, Shen Yu already had enough on her plate. Biased managers, check. Long, brutal work hours, check. The department beauty snatching her big story opportunity, check. But now another problem has reared its head and it comes packaged in a young and attractive military officer. He is on the hunt for some legendary space gold and he will get her to help him, whether she likes it or not.
Secrets are abound and Shen Yu soon finds that not everything is not as simple as it seems. Even her own past becomes questionable the more time she spends on the quest. Events from decades ago are rising up to haunt her and she needs to find out the truth before it’s too late. If only she had a better partner.

A young middle school student faces a life-altering choice. Destined for mediocrity and without a War Spiritual Bloodline, he dreams of transcending his ordinary existence and becoming a high-status War Spiritualist. His world is transformed when he becomes bound to the “”Godly Pet Evolution System,”” enabling him to activate his War Spiritual Bloodline and cultivate divine pets, even from the most unlikely sources.

The world he arrived in was a parallel version of Earth, yet it had been completely transformed.
Five hundred years ago, a strange and terrifying dark miasma descended upon the planet. Space itself cracked open, and through those rifts poured horrors beyond imagination. The land expanded to thousands of times its original size, reshaping continents and oceans alike.
Ordinary animals mutated into ferocious monsters, while mythical beings such as Godzilla, dragons, and phoenixes crossed over from unknown realms.
In a single night, eighty percent of humanity was wiped out.
The few survivors were preserved only because of a mysterious sanctuary known as the Light Domain.
At its very center stood the Tower of Ascension, a colossal structure with one hundred stairs. When humans reached the age of fifteen, they were allowed to challenge the tower.
The number of stairs they climbed determined their cultivation talent and bloodline.…

not-just-a-mage-lord-isekai:
Mechanics fix things.
Fighters break ‘em.
Those were the two truths Perry lived back on Earth. When he got isekai’d into a young noble with newfound magical powers, he found himself stuck with an awful choice. Try to survive on the Front, the mystical battleground where Hydras and Devils roamed free… Or find another way.
So he took an oath. An oath that made him a Magus Dominus. A mage lord. He’d escaped his fate, least for the moment.
For most his life, Perry was used to being alone. When he got sucked into Ro'an, he was suddenly thrust into the role of surrogate son to his loyal servant and half-brother to a tempestuous Storm mage. With their help, Perry prepared his best to be lord and protector for his domain. And if he fought a few monsters, and helped a few people along the way, well…
Mechanics fix things. And fighters break ‘em.
-Progression Fantasy with light LitRPG elements
-No romance
-Kingdom building and magic progression
